scope: Stage A, old frozen methods and weights only, zero risk training and zero threshold fitting

raw_and_analysis.K: left-multiply K by the half-pixel-centre crop/resize affine
raw_and_analysis.source_rgb: centre integer rectangle then Pillow LANCZOS, display-sRGB8
raw_and_analysis.render: native expected camera-Z, accumulated opacity and display-sRGB, no averaging camera-Z across boundaries
raw_and_analysis.display_labels: nearest only; counts from analysis arrays

legacy.same_host_locked_environment: equal FP32 words, finite, state and reason for 6 original M4 views. Compare v0.5 to v0.4 on each host where available. Record signed cross-host errors, thresholds and quota members separately; scientific T1 AP unchanged.

neural.padding_side: right and bottom, normalized zero, outside analysis support
neural.position: 2D bicubic with checkpoint-native grid, class token separate
neural.report: per-shape, finite and threshold changes; project asymmetric x/y, padding, edges

geometry_checks.points: off-axis and off-centre, differing focal lengths, landscape, portrait, crop edges, non-divisible pad; foreground/background split plus invalid Z and opacity
geometry_checks.cardinality: valid recorded non-cap checkpoint, inconsistent tensor rejection and preserved historical failure

bell.analysis: same landscape frustum for native 448x252 and legacy 256x256 with 256x144 content and 56 transparent padding rows on either side
bell.raw_views: original optical rendering at twice each registered native dimension, fixed poses, horizontal lens and sensor
bell.reference: independent authored-world target RGB held outside deployable evidence; after scores sealed
bell.primary_label: mean FP32 display-sRGB absolute channel difference strictly greater than 0.05
bell.comparison: native and legacy each reported on own content grid; separate aligned same-frustum 256x144 centre samples, explicit full and comparable denominators, nearest categorical support
bell.tie: ascending risk then flattened image row-major index
bell.domains: own and common finite domains, floor(q * number of eligible pixels), report unknown and reference denominators
bell.resources: wall, process CPU and RSS; same 4 neural threads; prior v0.4 performance separately

platforms.mac: default and full real neural paths
platforms.windows: native CPU, GPU upstream; actual installed wheels and arrays
platforms.linux: network-off arm64 container clean default install
platforms.verification: emit pair-specific model, shape and host statuses, absent coverage is explicit

access: Fixed-layout photographs authorized independently. Optional NBV commits all source choices or terminal failure before candidate photos. Linked target references are evaluator-only.
stop: A has an independent immutable commit, tag or local archival identity, installable artifacts, source/weight hashes, honest measured support matrix and numerical receipts before B.
